intents.intent: Find a learning-experience designer willing to mentor a teacher through an initial portfolio and help distinguish transferable skills from things I still need to learn.
Meet other career changers for reciprocal interview practice and encouragement on Saturday mornings, focusing on how to explain experience from a different industry.
Meet an educator moving into learning design who would value a bounded monthly mentoring conversation about portfolio choices and working on software training teams.
Find accessibility and learning-design peers to exchange practical ways of making workplace training easier to use, with each person bringing a different professional perspective.
Find an experienced accessibility testing practitioner to discuss moving from general QA into paid accessibility work and identify a realistic first learning project.
Meet software quality peers who want to rehearse short technical talks and exchange supportive feedback before presenting to a wider professional community.
Meet a tester entering accessibility practice for a bounded mentoring exchange about learning through real interfaces, describing limitations, and defining a useful review scope.
Find fellow career changers to practice turning experience from earlier jobs into clear interview examples and keep each other company during a first job search in a new field.
Meet industry peers who help people learn software when dense instructions get in the way; exchange plain-language learning design and practical accessibility testing approaches.
Expand my frontend career network by meeting experienced engineers considering a full-time on-site senior role in London.
Find experienced professionals moving into climate-related work to compare learning plans, practice explaining a sector change, and exchange what we know from our previous industries.
Meet a software practitioner who wants a friendly rehearsal audience for a short professional talk; exchange feedback on making technical stories understandable.
